about_pullquote: We do the job properly, first time — no shortcuts, no mess left behind.
about_para_1: EKH Painting & Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Sutton Coldfield and Birmingham for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many painters rush through jobs and leave customers disappointed. From the first consultation to the final coat, we're meticulous, friendly, and transparent about cost and timescale.
about_para_2: Every project — whether a single bedroom or a commercial refurb — receives the same care and craftsmanship. Our customers return because we listen, respect their home, and deliver exactly what we promise. We're fully insured, happy to provide references, and we always leave a clean site.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About EKH

reviews.text: Had EKH paint our entire downstairs and they were fantastic. Really professional, tidy, and the finish is perfect. They sorted everything with minimal fuss and were in and out on schedule. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: I was nervous about having work done, but the team put me at ease straight away. They explained what they were doing, moved around the house respectfully, and the final result is stunning. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen redecorating and new wallpaper in the hallway. EKH did a brilliant job — no mess, really attentive to detail, and fair pricing. Much better than the last lot we used. Top marks.
reviews.author: Paul K.
